labels.text: section 68(b)(1)(A): the applicable amount for a joint return or a surviving spouse

section 68(b)(1)(A): $300,000, unindexed statutory base; inflation-adjusted under section 68(b)(2) (base year 2012) for years after 2013 — SOURCE_GAP for any year's published amount. Section 68 itself is inapplicable to any taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017 and before January 1, 2026 (section 68(f)); this value is read only in a taxable year outside that suspension window.
